description: The plot illustrates the relative change across different neural network layer groups for various configurations of token multipliers and bit precisions, evaluated on LB-Avg and RULER4k metrics. The x-axis represents categorical layer groups across five discrete data points, with visible labels for "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32", preceded by an initial unlabeled point. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" and uses a linear scale with values expressed in percentages (%), featuring visible tick marks at -15%, -5%, 0%, and 5%. The plot contains five lines tracking across the five x-axis points. A grey dashed line without markers, representing the "Baseline of 4x tokens, 4-bit", starts at 0% at the initial point and rises steadily to end at approximately 12% at Layer29-32. A solid yellow line with circular markers ("LB-Avg of 2x tokens, 8-bit") starts at approximately 2%, increases steadily across the layer groups, and ends at roughly 12%. A solid red line with square markers ("LB-Avg of 4x tokens, 4-bit") follows a similar upward trend, starting near 2%, reaching about 5% at Layer13-20, and ending at approximately 11%. A solid light blue line with circular markers ("RULER4k of 2x tokens, 8-bit") starts near 0%, rises to about 4% at Layer5-12, declines to approximately -1% at Layer13-20, and then increases to end at roughly 10%. Finally, a solid dark blue line with square markers ("RULER4k of 4x tokens, 4-bit") starts at approximately -1%, rises slightly to 2% at Layer5-12, experiences a sharp decline to a low of roughly -14% at Layer13-20, and then rises sharply to end at approximately 9% at Layer29-32.
